payload.title: Console nav page visibility is a hand-written mirror of route guards keyed on the global role and the tenant's module list, with no access layer on a page, so the rail can offer pages the API refuses and listing a module-private page in Company type-checks
evidence: web/shell/src/console/nav/pageAccess.ts:1-15 (documented as the nav's hand-kept mirror of the route guards)
web/shell/src/console/nav/pageAccess.ts:26-39 (decides by tenant module list, global requiredRoles and a capability)
web/shell/src/console/nav/types.ts:107-118 (page gates are global ConsoleRole lists and flags; no layer)
web/shell/src/console/nav/types.ts:137-146 (WorkspaceDef carries an optional module; Company has none, and nothing types a page's layer)
web/shell/src/console/nav/pages/finance.ts:14 (FINANCE_ROLES lets any global MODULE_MANAGER see finance in every workspace)
payload.rule_violated: Plan PKG-02/PKG-34: one pure decideAccess decides every access, including the nav, so the UI cannot offer what the API refuses.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-34, release R10.
